source: Direct author statements in the development conversation
note: LL01 is an earlier build of this version; the fixes below make the current source differ from it, so this run is not the release's evidence.

steps.1 CAPT + PICK: the capture button, CAPTU: yes; the FILL capture is a press of PAGE (holding it does nothing more), the checklist said hold
steps.3 ONCE with UP: armed, recording, record: yes; the banner says ARMED, RECORDING, then TAKEN, and TAKEN could read better (now RECORDED)
steps.5 GLOB SND: DEL and REV stay across patt: yes; on a pattern without LOOPER the track's own values apply

findings: With GLOB on ALL the filter went back to each pattern's own values on a pattern change (fixed: GLOB's filter set missed TYPE, FREQ, RESO, ENV and ATK).
An arm could only be called off by turning MODE to OFF and back; stock clears with STOP pressed twice (fixed: STOP while stopped calls it off).
Armed while stopped, ONCE and CAPT recorded only after the first loop had passed (fixed for ONCE: an arm made while stopped records the first loop from PLAY).
Holding SRC switched pages at once; stock shows the knob values while SRC is held (fixed: SRC is left to the stock page switch).
Turning a page 2 knob showed no header message as the stock pages do (added).
MAX was to be renamed and a value added that follows the pattern's M.LEN, N/A for INF or over 128 steps (now LEN with PT.LEN).
In PICK, PTCH and WARP the loop restarts when the looper track's trig key is pressed (not yet reproduced in the emulator).
A click at the end of each recording (already listed; loops are now cut to the exact length with a short fade at each end).
limitations: The run time was not stated.
Firmware was not read back from the device; the build is identified by its SysEx hash.
